Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride

Grinnell, IA · Gravel

Beginner friendly

Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Grinnell, IA. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Bikes To You. About 20–25 miles, routes posted ahead; shorter options some weeks.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: routes posted ahead; shorter options some weeks.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride group ride

A small-town weekly gravel ride from the Bikes To You shop, ending at Grinnell Craft Brewhouse. 20 to 25 miles on posted routes. Free loaner bikes through the Grinnell Bike Share. Not sure about gravel? The same group runs a shorter Gravel Curious ride Thursdays at 5:30 pm.
